title: error.v1
description: One explicit failure, rejection or quarantine record. Specified by 02-contracts-and-data.md section 2.3 (stable rejection/quarantine codes), section 4 (the mutation conflict table) and section 10 (error and availability semantics). The code catalog is CLOSED and versioned: free-text detail may supplement but can never replace the code (the same rule 02 section 4 states for exclusion-reason.v1). Failures are explicit in the ledger, fail OPEN with respect to the developer's original workflow by returning noop, and fail CLOSED for knowledge access. Adding a code requires a schema version change.

error_code.description: Closed kernel catalog. trace_batch_span_mismatch, span_not_completed, invalid_timestamp_interval, self_parent_span, parent_span_cycle and signal_identity_conflict are the adapter quarantine/rejection codes named in 02 section 2.3. Missing external parents and incomplete traces are NOT errors - they are recorded as unresolved coverage, not silently repaired.

subject_ref.description: What the error is about: a batch ID, source_id, item reference or dependency name. Null when the failure has no single subject.

detail.description: Free-form supplementary detail. Deliberately OPEN. It may explain a code but can never replace one.
